positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rancho Santa Margarita, California, United States

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Hub Link is an on-line personal information handler where you can link to all of your website accounts and quickly update your addresses, phone numbers, emails and payment cards without having to individually log into each site

What I have accomplished: 
-Created the registration and Login with unique security features to secure the login credentials and creation.
-Implemented dynamic routing that will allow access to pages depending on the role of the logged in user. This routing will also render web different features depending on the role of the logged in user – such as the navbar or an admin panel. 
-Created a file service that integrated AWS where files are uploaded to our AWS server and the URLs are saved into the HubLink Microsoft SQL Server. 
-Incorporated Stripe to build a subscription based model for users to sign up with HubLink services. I also used Stripe to allow admins to create and manage subscriptions – including 
-Built an admin dashboard which allows an admin view site analytics and manage user memberships and status.
-Incorporated Twilio to build 2-Factor Authentication that users can opt in to using on a login. This service will send a PIN to their phone that they can confirm on our site. A user is also able to have that authentication remembered for a custom amount of time so they won’t have to authenticate for some number of days/months.

positions.title: Computer Lab Technician
positions.description: Provided technical assistance to under-represented persons as a member of the UC Village Academic Center. Various tasks included network, hardware and software support using Microsoft Office Suite, Google Suite, and UC Berkeley Email Network services
